input.summary: Vembanad Botanicals (V03) sent proposal and rosemary COA (VB-RM-2411-03, retest 30 Nov 2026, before 20 Dec need-by). Buyer-side ask sent for a later-retest COA. Vendor replied with current batch VB-RM-2609-11 (made 14 Sep 2026, COA 18 Sep 2026, retest 13 Sep 2028) for RM-008, but reports rosmarinic acid 10.4% by HPLC against our 20% spec. Potency shortfall escalated to buyer; not resolved. Knockout gaps still open: Q5 (COA per line, batch/mfg/retest for all 10 lines; only RM-008 covered), Q9 (SDS and leave-on scalp suitability under Cosmetics Rules 2020). Q8 (manufacturer or trader, second source, delivery/rejection records) non-knockout, open. No refusals or promises. Vendor reply requested by 14 Nov 2026.

input.title: V03 Vembanad: RM-008 rosemary extract potency below spec
input.detail: Vembanad's correction gives new batch VB-RM-2609-11 (made 14 Sep 2026, COA 18 Sep 2026, retest 13 Sep 2028), so the earlier retest-date problem is fixed. However the same COA reports rosmarinic acid 10.4% by HPLC, while RFx RM-008 spec is 20% rosmarinic acid. This does not meet spec. Decision needed: reject this batch and ask for a conforming 20% batch, or accept a revised spec/deviation. I have not contacted the vendor on potency. Also still open: knockout Q5 (COA for all 10 lines) and Q9 (SDS and leave-on suitability); these will be requested in the next email.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: thank you, outstanding items
input.body:
Dear Meera,

Thank you for the updated rosemary COA for batch VB-RM-2609-11. We have noted the retest date of 13 September 2028. We are reviewing the rosmarinic acid result against our specification and will come back to you on it.

Items still needed before we can progress your quote, by 14 November 2026:

1. Certificate of Analysis (knockout): For each of the other nine lines (RM-001 to RM-007, RM-009, RM-010), provide a COA from a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. Covering the 6-month supply window (need-by from 20 December 2026) is required.
2. Safety Data Sheets and suitability (knockout): Provide the SDS for each of the 10 materials and confirm that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
3. Manufacturer and supply chain: Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
